Bellevue’s transfer rules

  • At least 15 semester credits must be completed at Bellevue.

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 6–12 credits per university term is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Uses the $459 online rate. The $250 military rate and Campus@Work or Guild funding are not applied.
  • Individual course fees ("Additional fees may apply for individual courses") are not included.
  • 6–12 credits per term (three terms a year) is a planning assumption.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
  • 6 proposed outside units retain the eligibility conditions shown on their course rows.

Questions

Does Sophia English Composition I transfer to Bellevue University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia English Composition I for EN 101 Composition I (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Bellevue, so ask Bellevue to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia English Composition II transfer to Bellevue University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia English Composition II for EN 102 Composition II (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Bellevue, so ask Bellevue to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Bellevue University’s Associate Degree in Multidisciplinary Studies?

Bellevue’s published limit for this 60-credit degree is 45 semester credits from other sources. At least 15 semester credits must be completed at Bellevue. This plan proposes 6 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Bellevue University?

In this plan, 54 semester credits are taken at Bellevue, including STS 110 Skills for Success, MA 100 Introduction to Algebra, EN 100 Introduction to English, CA 107 Public Speaking in the Digital Age and PS 151 Introduction to American Institutions (Human Behavior). Bellevue requires at least 15 semester credits at Bellevue.

Can I choose my own courses in this plan?

Yes. 39 semester credits are open choices, such as Quantitative, Problem-Solving, and Technology (select two: DSC 101, SYS 101, MA 215, CIS 245, ECN 201, CYBR 250, CIS 111, CIS 115, CIS 121, CIS 212), Communication, Collaboration, and Leadership (select two: CA 105, CIS 133, CA 110, CA 209, PY 101, SO 101, PH 106) and Additional Requirements (select four courses from the combined major lists). You pick a course Bellevue allows, then ask Bellevue to confirm it counts.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $26,535 to $27,735 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Bellevue University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Bellevue’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school to confirm 2 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Pick a course for 13 open course choices in this plan, then ask the school to confirm they count. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Bellevue’s decisions.
